author: strawbvrries
quote: The theme song was good music is an important part of games after all. However as a whole the game feels like it was good on paper, but poorly executed. Every NPC was given voice lines yet they did not go deeper on that. If there are voice lines I would expect lore behind that which would be prevalent later but they didn't do that it would have made for some good side quests.  That way it would have given more life to the world of GTA and justified that price. Therefore when looking at the way how this game took 13 years, comparing it to other games and holding onto the price point and that theres no physical disk I can not give it a high score. If the gaming industry would result into games like this I would be disappointed with how soulless and deprived from potential and creativity it would be.
